canonicalIngredients.name: kashmiri chilli powder
observations: 2 tsp degi mirch, or 1/2 tsp cayenne + 1 tsp paprika (s2)

canonicalIngredients.name: shallots or onion
observations: 1.25 cup sliced shallot/onion, marked optional and non-traditional (s1)

canonicalIngredients.name: hot water or stock
observations: 1 cup, up to 5 cups as needed (s1)

canonicalIngredients.name: potatoes
observations: 2 medium, large cubes, slow-cooker variant only (s2)

causalSequence: optionally marinate lamb in yogurt 1-24 h (1 source)
temper whole spices (cinnamon, cardamom, cloves, bay, cumin) in ghee ~1 min
brown shallots/onion 5-10 min; add garlic-ginger 1 min
sear lamb until colour gone, 2-6 min
stir in yogurt whisked with chilli, fennel, dried ginger, salt — off heat or in batches to stop curdling
add hot water/stock; simmer covered on low until lamb tender (40 min stovetop marinated cut to ~2 h bone-in; slow cooker 5 h; pressure cooker 15 min)
uncover, simmer to reduce until gravy slightly thick
rest, garnish coriander; serve with basmati rice or naan
techniqueFacts: kashmiri chilli powder is the colour lever: deep red with mild heat, all 3 sources
fennel + dried ginger are the signature Kashmiri flavour pair (2 sources; 3rd uses fennel seeds)
yogurt curdles if dumped on high heat — add off heat or in batches (2 sources); 3rd marinates the lamb in it instead
slow simmer until fall-apart is the tenderness lever; time varies 1-2 h stovetop by cut
traditional rogan josh has no tomato; body comes from yogurt, reduction, bone marrow (1 source emphatic)
gravy thickens by uncovered reduction or optional fried-onion+yogurt paste — no flour or starch in any source (naturally gluten free)
GF caution: asafoetida (optional, 1 source) is commonly cut with wheat flour — omit or use certified GF hing
GF caution: served with naan/roti (wheat) in all sources; rice serve is the GF option
resting a few hours before serving develops flavour (1 source)
